## Change

Describe the actual problem and resulting behavior. State whether scope is FE,
BE, shared API, documentation or CI. Identify scaffolding that is not executable.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. State skipped checks and why.
Include UI source/node references or API contract links when applicable.

## Limits

Record remaining design/API/runtime decisions and material warnings.
Do not claim a manual approval, backend test, deployment or review that did not occur.
